# MedAssist AI Documentation

> MedAssist AI is a full-stack educational healthcare platform featuring an AI clinical assistant, 22 interactive clinical scoring calculators, deterministic FDA boxed warning drug interaction screening, and literature citation grounding via NCBI PubMed.

## Getting Started & Tutorials

- [Getting Started Tutorial](docs/tutorials/getting-started.md): 15-minute quickstart guide to clone, install, test, and build the project locally.
- [How to Run Tests and Verification Checks](docs/how-to/develop/run-tests.md): Procedures for executing backend, frontend, dataset, and multi-tier verification suites.
- [How to Add a Clinical Scoring Tool](docs/how-to/develop/add-clinical-calculator.md): Adding a clinical calculator in ClinicalCalculatorsModal with safety invariants.
- [How to Add a Deterministic DDI Rule](docs/how-to/develop/add-ddi-rule.md): Expanding the 23 FDA Boxed Warning screener with regex word boundaries and tests.
- [How to Deploy with Docker Compose](docs/how-to/operate/deploy.md): Orchestrating containerized services with Nginx ingress, MongoDB auth, and health checks.
- [How to Perform Rollback & Disaster Recovery](docs/how-to/operate/rollback.md): Rolling back containers, restoring MongoDB collections, and switching AI model providers.
- [How to Train and Validate LoRA Adapters](docs/how-to/ai/finetune-lora.md): Offline fine-tuning runbook for MedQuAD/PubMedQA LoRA adapters using PEFT and PyTorch.
- [Repository Overview](README.md): Top-level overview, quickstart instructions, and architecture summary.
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer setup, code standards, git workflow, and test requirements.
- [Agent Developer Guide](AGENTS.md): Instructions, invariants, and directory map for AI coding agents.
- [Security Policy](SECURITY.md): Private vulnerability reporting procedures, supported versions, and AI security scope.
- [Support Policy](SUPPORT.md): Support channels, bug filing instructions, and scope definitions.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Historical release notes and unreleased improvements adhering to Keep a Changelog.
- [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Contributor Covenant v2.1 community pledge and enforcement standards.

## Reference Specifications

- [Configuration Reference](docs/reference/configuration.md): Exhaustive environment variable reference covering all 34 configuration keys.
- [Authentication and Session Architecture](docs/reference/api/authentication.md): Specification of JWT lifecycles, Web Locks token renewal mutex, and cookie flags.
- [API Error Catalog and Status Codes](docs/reference/api/errors.md): Directory of REST API error codes, JSON envelopes, and client retry policies.
- [Database Architecture & MongoDB Schemas](docs/reference/database.md): Entity relationship model, collection schemas, indexes, and BSON size limits.
- [Frontend Architecture Reference](docs/reference/frontend.md): React 19 SPA structure, Vite 6 build pipeline, and context providers.
- [Observability, Logging, and Probes Catalog](docs/reference/observability-catalog.md): Structured JSON logs, correlation IDs, and health probe contracts.
- [Clinical Tools & DDI Screener Specification](docs/reference/ai/tools.md): Technical inventory and formulas for the 22 clinical risk tools and 23 FDA rules.
- [Biomedical RAG Pipeline Reference](docs/reference/ai/rag-pipeline.md): End-to-end specification of PubMed literature retrieval, relevance ranking, and citation grounding.
- [Clinical Prompt Registry & Directives](docs/reference/ai/prompts.md): System prompt directives, audience profile adaptations, and emergency intercepts.
- [Service Level Objectives & Error Budgets](docs/reference/slo.md): Availability indicators, p95 latency targets, and budget depletion policies.
- [Clinical Calculators Reference](frontend/src/components/tools/README.md): Reference formulas, risk tiers, and validation gates for all 22 clinical tools.
- [Backend Services Reference](backend/services/README.md): Details on answer generation, safety filters, citation grounding, and crypto vaults.
- [Coverage Matrix](docs/_meta/coverage-matrix.md): Exhaustive coverage matrix of HTTP endpoints, env variables, calculators, and DDI rules.

## Architectural Records & Decisions

- [ADR 0000: Use Markdown Architectural Decision Records](docs/records/decisions/0000-use-markdown-architectural-decision-records.md): Decision to adopt MADR format for architectural history.
- [ADR 0001: In-Memory MongoDB for Isolated Backend Testing](docs/records/decisions/0001-use-in-memory-mongodb-for-isolated-backend-testing.md): Hermetic backend testing using MongoMemoryServer.
- [ADR 0002: Deterministic Regex Drug Interaction Screener](docs/records/decisions/0002-implement-deterministic-regex-drug-interaction-screener.md): Zero-latency screening of 23 FDA boxed warning medication pairs.
- [ADR 0003: Web Locks Mutex for Single-Flight JWT Renewal](docs/records/decisions/0003-use-web-locks-mutex-for-single-flight-jwt-renewal.md): Preventing token refresh race conditions across concurrent requests and browser tabs.
- [ADR 0004: Two-Phase Chat Generation and Persistence Handshake](docs/records/decisions/0004-two-phase-chat-generation-and-persistence-handshake.md): Decoupling LLM generation from database writes with exchange idempotency.
- [ADR 0005: Unassessed Defaults and Complete Record Gating for Clinical Calculators](docs/records/decisions/0005-unassessed-defaults-and-complete-record-gating-for-clinical-calculators.md): Clinical safety invariants across all 22 interactive clinical tools.
- [ADR 0006: AES-256-GCM Vault for User Provider Credentials](docs/records/decisions/0006-aes-256-gcm-vault-for-provider-credentials.md): Cryptographic authenticated encryption and key rotation for personal provider API keys.
- [Release Process and Quality Gates](docs/release/release-process.md): SemVer release standards, automated verification gates, and rollback criteria.

## Threat Models & Model Cards

- [System STRIDE Threat Model](docs/records/threat-models/system.md): STRIDE threat assessment across client, ingress, API, database, and external providers.
- [OWASP Top 10 for LLMs 2025 Threat Model](docs/records/threat-models/ai.md): Defensive evaluations against prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, hallucination, and excessive agency.
- [Multi-Provider System Card](docs/records/model-cards/system-card.md): Model details, intended use, clinical safety controls, and multi-tier verification metrics.

## Operations & Runbooks

- [Operational Runbooks Directory](docs/runbooks/index.md): On-call severity matrix, alert triggers, and incident checklists.
- [High API Error Rate Runbook](docs/runbooks/api-error-rate-high.md): Triage and resolution for 5xx spikes on backend routes.
- [Database Connection Saturation Runbook](docs/runbooks/db-connection-saturation.md): Diagnosis and recovery for MongoDB connection pool exhaustion or failover.
- [LLM Provider Outage or Rate Limit Runbook](docs/runbooks/llm-provider-outage-or-rate-limit.md): Mitigation procedures for external AI 429/503 errors and multi-provider failover.
- [Drug Interaction Screener Alert Runbook](docs/runbooks/drug-interaction-screener-alert.md): Handling false positive reports and maintaining the 23 FDA boxed warning rules.
- [Production Deployment Runbook](docs/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md): Container orchestration, TLS ingress, and production deployment procedures.
